title: EdgeEvidenceBundleRef
description: Edge tarafı kanıt paketi referansı (kiosk-emitted): bir dataset için tüm kanıt artefactlarını tek tek (per-type single ref) bağlar. Edge-side ref'ler zorunlu; platform-side ref'ler doldurulana kadar nullable. Dataset-katmanı aggregation (id listeleri) için bkz. schemas/datasets/evidence_bundle_ref.v1. Edge interface/contracts/schemas/edge/evidence_bundle_ref.v1 vendored kopyasıyla `properties` + `required` düzeyinde EŞDEĞERDİR; bayt-özdeşlik BEKLENMEZ — vendored kopya `additionalProperties: false`, kanonik `unevaluatedProperties: false` idiomunu kullanır (bilinçli ve 9/9 şemada tutarlı; 2026-07-31'de ölçüldü). Doğrulama: tests/test_vendored_parity.py.

manifest_ref.description: Reference to the intake manifest artifact.

scan_report_edge_ref.description: Reference to the AV1 edge scan report.

attestation_edge_ref.description: Reference to the edge attestation record.

scan_report_center_ref.description: Reference to the AV2 center scan report. Null until platform scan completes.

verification_report_ref.description: Reference to the hash verification report. Null until platform verification.

calibration_certificate_ref.description: Reference to the calibration certificate. Null until calibration is verified.

qc_report_ref.description: Reference to the QC report artifact. Null until QC is complete.
